overview: AgentPO is a framework that enhances multi-agent system collaboration by using reinforcement learning (GRPO) to train a lightweight Collaborator agent to guide a fixed, powerful Actor agent, optimizing interaction dynamics within fixed topologies like Hint-Actor and Critic-Actor.

modules.name: Data Processing & Prompt Management
modules.description: Handles loading and formatting of mathematical reasoning datasets (MATH, AIME24, etc.) and constructs structured prompts for different agent roles based on the topology-specific templates defined in the paper.

modules.name: Agent Topology Engine
modules.description: Implements the interaction protocols for various topologies, including Feed-forward (Hint-Actor), Feedback (Critic-Actor), and complex multi-agent structures (Debate, Role Assignment), defining the context flow and signal integration between agents.

modules.name: LLM Policy Interfaces
modules.description: Provides wrappers for the Actor and Collaborator language models, managing the distinction between frozen Actor parameters and trainable Collaborator parameters, and handling standard LLM forward passes and generation logits.

modules.name: Reward & Verification Module
modules.description: Computes the binary reward signal by comparing the Actor's final solution against the ground-truth using exact match and mathematical verification functions (e.g., Math-Verify) to determine the success of the collaborative rollout.

modules.name: GRPO Optimizer
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm, calculating intra-group advantages, applying probability ratio clipping, and integrating KL divergence regularization against a reference policy to stably update the Collaborator.

modules.name: Reinforcement Learning Training Loop
modules.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end RL training process, managing the sampling of problem batches, executing multi-step rollouts within the defined topology, storing trajectories, and triggering GRPO policy updates.

modules.name: Inference & Rollout Engine
modules.description: Manages efficient text generation for both training rollouts and final evaluation, integrating with high-throughput inference backends (like vLLM) and handling diverse sampling configurations (temperature, top-p).

modules.name: Baseline Methods Suite
modules.description: Contains the implementations of comparison baselines such as Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency, Self-Refine, Multi-Agent Debate, Step-back Abstraction, Quality-Diversity, Role Assignment, and EvoAgent.

modules.name: Hybrid API-Local Agent Manager
modules.description: Facilitates the hybrid system setup where a local, open-source Collaborator is trained to guide a black-box, API-based Actor (e.g., Qwen-Plus), handling the asynchronous interface between local RL updates and remote API calls.

modules.name: Evaluation & Benchmarking Suite
modules.description: Aggregates model outputs across multiple mathematical benchmarks, computes the primary Pass@1 accuracy metric, and formats the results into comparative tables against baseline methods.

modules.name: Efficiency & Cost Analysis
modules.description: Profiles the computational efficiency of different methods by tracking token consumption during inference, calculating cost ratios, and analyzing the accuracy-vs-efficiency trade-offs.

modules.name: Configuration & Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Manages experiment hyperparameters (clipping thresholds, learning rates, batch sizes), model checkpointing, and logs training metrics and evaluation results for reproducibility and analysis.
